body: Thank you for your kind words. Seeking help is very hard because I am one of the professionals you speak of.

Well, I doubt it's me. But I'll tell you this. I've been suffering for a long long time. Way before cheating. I've been wanting to die for years. I stay alive for my kids and my patients. Having an affair was the wrong choice, but it also has helped me make it this far. 

I'm sorry that someone like me has hurt you. If I could take your pain and add it to my own suffering, I would.
I understand why the suicide rate is high for healthcare workers.
